objectives.statement: Form yes/no questions by placing the finite verb before the subject.
Recognize and build simple negative yes/no questions with verb, subject, and ikke in the right order.
Form wh-questions with a question word followed by the finite verb, and recognize wh-subject questions without an extra subject.
Use får to ask simple permission questions such as får jeg.

notes: Must include yes/no questions, negative yes/no questions, wh-questions, and simple permission questions with får. Include wh-subject questions such as 'Hvem kommer?' where no extra subject follows the verb.
